headline: Weathered Expanse Lines Shift Again; Palantine Berm Swings Back to Wardens
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has turned once more. It now stands two Warden strongpoints to five Colonial, with two positions gone neutral, a fresh shift from the three-to-six Colonial tally of the last edition; Crow's Nest and Frostmarch remain the scenes of the sharpest work, and the hex has absorbed better than twenty-one thousand casualties in a day. Palantine Berm swung back to the Warden ledger, six bases to one, Leiri Hermanni and The Droll hottest in the past two hours. Stlican Shelf holds at five Colonial to four Warden around Fort Hoarfrost, its actions quieter. Mooring County stands eleven Warden to one Colonial, Gravekeeper's Holdfast the busiest single ground of the war, though its event traffic has cooled since the small hours. Callahans Passage remains entirely Warden and Farranac Coast entirely Colonial, the former still the costliest quiet front at close to fifteen thousand casualties in the day. Nevish Line's Grief Mother, Stonecradle's Reach and Linn Mercy's Rotdust also logged actions. No conquest has been declared.
